author: IGN
description:
True power, the divine right to rule, is something she was born with. Meet Azula and see the character in action in this latest trailer for Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game, an upcoming 2D anime action fighting game based on the Avatar: The Last Airbender and The Legend of Korra series, developed by Gameplay Group International in collaboration with Paramount. 


Azula's unraveling psyche and duality turns into her greatest strength, from poise and precision to mellifluous madness. Unlike a certain exiled prince, she settles for nothing less than perfection.


Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game will be available on PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X/S, and PC via Steam on July 2, 2026. It is also coming to Nintendo Switch and Nintendo Switch 2 at a later date.


Preorder on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2424420/Avatar_Legends_The_Fighting_Game/

https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10018989/

https://www.xbox.com/en-us
title: Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game - Official Azula Reveal Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the character trailer for Mr. Karate, the mysterious karate master with strength and skill beyond compare. His name and visage evoke memories of a fearsome fighter who, long ago, sowed discord throughout South Town. And yet his strength and skill are all his own—a polished practitioner of the Kyokugen style whose sheer might surpasses current head Marco Rodrigues himself. The verdict among all who fall to the mask is brutally clear: what lies beneath is no mere man, but a true tiger unleashed. The face—and mask—of Kyokugen returns on May 27. Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves is available now on PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and Epic Games Store).

title: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Official Mr. Karate Character Trailer

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Starpath, new kind of space game that avoids the tropes and bridges the gaps between space sim, survival craft and cozy game in a vast procedurally generated universe. Build your starship alone or with friends and explore a seamless universe. Plot a course, burn your thrusters, and chill out in your ship while you drift through space and approach orbit around distant worlds, and discover whether we are truly alone. Starpath is coming soon to PC (Steam).

title: Starpath - Official Announcement Trailer

description:
Check out the Dead by Daylight x Jason collaboration trailer for a peek at what to expect as Jason comes to the asymmetrical multiplayer horror game. Trapped forever in a realm of eldritch evil where even death is not an escape, four determined survivors face a bloodthirsty killer in a vicious game of nerve and wits. Pick a side and step into a world of tension and terror. The Dead by Daylight x Jason collaboration will be available on June 16.

author: IGN
description:
Trying to cross off the Paranormal Investigator challenge from your Batcave board in LEGO Batman: Legacy of the Dark Knight? If you are hunting down the elusive Batman supervillain Gentleman Ghost but keep coming up empty, you aren't alone. This spectral rogue requires a highly specific trigger to reveal himself, and our quick guide shows you exactly where to go on the map and how to use your camera mode to snap the perfect selfie.

This step-by-step walkthrough covers how to unlock the North Island by completing the Chapter 2 Joker missions, where to find the hidden path leading toward Arkham Asylum, and how to spot the ectoplasm puddle indicator. Learn the exact photo mode tricks needed to make the Gentleman Ghost spawn so you can easily complete the challenge board.

#ign #gaming
title: Lego Batman - How to Find Gentleman Ghost (Legacy of the Dark Knight)

author: IGN
description:
Kane Parsons made a name for himself with his unbearably eerie Backrooms short films on YouTube, almost immediately drawing the attention of Hollywood mainstays like A24, James Wan, and Osgood Perkins. Now, Backrooms is a feature film, and Parsons sat down with IGN's Tom Jorgensen to explain how his love of video games like Portal, Half-Life, and Minecraft served as the bedrock of his passion for filmmaking, and what it was like directing powerhouse performers like Chiwetel Ejiofor and Renate Reinsve in his feature debut.

#ign #gaming
title: Backrooms: How Kane Parsons Turned A Video Game Design Flaw Into Pure Nightmare Fuel
